name: json-to-types
description: Paste-free type generation: point it at sample JSON — an API response, a config file, a JSONL log — and get TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, JSON Schema, Python dataclasses and Go structs. Multiple samples are merged so fields that are sometimes missing become optional and nulls become nullable; dates, emails and URLs are recognised; nested objects get proper names. Mark fields and add descriptions in a table before exporting. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 不用复制粘贴就能生成类型：选一份示例 JSON——接口返回、配置文件、JSONL 日志——生成 TypeScript 接口、Zod 校验、JSON Schema、Python dataclass 和 Go 结构体。多个样本会合并推断，有时缺失的字段标为可选，出现 null 的标为可空；能识别日期、邮箱和网址；嵌套对象会起好名字。导出前可在表格里调整字段并写说明。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
